name: GitHub
description: Manage GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and Actions in Cindy. When you open a PR, an interactive card helps you submit it and automatically follows CI and reviews until merge. Uses the local GitHub login. Supports github.com.
whenToUse: Use for github.com repositories and links; use GitLab for GitLab instances. Handles issues, PRs, reviews, merges, repositories, Actions, releases, search, and logs. Use the PR card to ask about opening a PR and to show its status afterwards. Uses the local GitHub login or a fallback token.

list_tools.description: List this plugin's 117 GitHub operations across issues, pulls, repo, commits, actions, releases, search, users, orgs, events, notifications, gists, git_data, reactions, and meta. With no category, return category names, counts, and descriptions; with a category, return every operation in that category with its description and parameters.

call_tool.description: Run a GitHub operation returned by list_tools, passing args according to its parameter schema. Repository operations require explicit owner and repo values, which may be derived from git remote get-url origin when working in a repository. API-link fields are removed by default except html_url; set raw=true for the original JSON. Results over 50KB are written to the session work directory and only the file path is returned; out_file can set the path. Downloads such as Actions artifacts or log ZIPs require a destination directory in the top-level save_dir field of ghost_call.

pr_card.description: Show a PR card in the conversation. When the agent wants to ask whether to open a pull request, call this instead of asking in text: pass repo, head and base, optionally with commits and files as a change summary (no title or description is needed yet). After the user clicks Open PR / Open as draft or explicitly asks for it, the agent commits and opens the PR; clicks reach the current task's agent as hidden messages sent by this plugin. After creating the PR, pass card_id and pr to update the same card: it shows the PR status and offers an Auto-follow until merged button plus settings to rename the task and follow automatically after opening, and settings / todo in the result say what is left to do; set renamed / following only for actions already done. Each background follow-up round can pass card_id to refresh the status; add to_latest when the user should look at it, to move the card to the latest round. The card appears only in Cindy's own conversation view, not in IM channels.
